# The certificates a release is signed with, pinned by the SHA-256 of their DER
# bytes, and the day each one stops being able to sign.
#
# One line per certificate: a name, the digest, the expiry date. Blank lines and
# lines starting with # are ignored. Read by .github/scripts/sign_release.py,
# which refuses to sign with any other certificate and refuses a file that any
# other certificate signed. This file is the one written copy of each digest, so
# the script and anything that later checks a published release cannot drift
# apart.
#
# A digest rather than a name. A second code signing certificate on the same
# machine, a renewal or one made for testing, signs just as willingly, and the
# release page looks the same either way. A renewal is a DIFFERENT certificate,
# so its line here moves with it.
#
# Nothing about either certificate's subject is written here. Both carry the
# maintainer's name and both become public with the first signed release, which
# is a thing to say once rather than spread through a repository.
#
# windows-code-signing: issued by Certum Code Signing 2021 CA. The key is on a
# cryptographic card, which is why signing is a step a person runs on their own
# machine rather than a job on a runner. The same card signs the maintainer's
# other projects. The digest and the date were read from the Windows certificate
# store with the card's certificate in it on 2026-11-18.
#
# apple-developer-id: a Developer ID Application certificate issued by Apple's
# Developer ID Certification Authority, in a keychain on the maintainer's Mac.
# It sits in two keychains there, so the name "Developer ID Application" names
# two entries, and the digest is what makes the choice unambiguous. Read from
# that Mac on 2026-11-18.
#
# A signature outlives its certificate, because every one made for a release
# carries a timestamp. Nothing new can be signed after the date.

windows-code-signing 47b79ad3cfa53ef846cad03a59148f8c981d0b1196891e48b8c8d7982b10c148 2027-08-19
apple-developer-id   c656a279aba94f535d6fcf9aff1ce05cd51295aea52295677ae5e1f1d7d77794 2029-10-27
